description: Add work item and boards support as the Azure DevOps equivalent of gh issues: ado workitem (aliases wi, issue) create/list/view/edit/close/reopen/comment/assign/link/unlink/delete, ado workitem query (WIQL and saved queries), ado sprint and ado board views; process-aware types and states (Agile, Scrum, Basic, CMMI); --json/--jq/--template on read commands
